plan: Parse recipe, request, and catalog into internal structures.
Implement substitution resolution with cycle detection and priority ordering.
Apply substitutions recursively to handle additional ingredients.
Scale quantities and yields by target_yield / original_yield.
Check equipment availability and exclusions after all substitutions.
Generate adapted recipe dict with all fields.
Implement print_original to return authored_text unchanged.
Ensure no input mutation and deterministic behavior.
mechanisms: Use Fraction for all numeric operations.
Maintain a mapping from ingredient id to current ingredient state.
Use a recursive function to resolve substitutions for an ingredient, tracking visited ids to detect cycles.
Collect all reasons in a set and sort at the end.
Apply wording changes by replacing old substrings in instruction strings.
Sort equipment list and check against available_equipment set.
Use catalog order as tie-breaker by iterating in original order after sorting by priority.
